item.title: England knocked out of Women's Rugby League World Cup by Samoa
item.body: England are out of the Women's Rugby League World Cup after losing to Samoa. Freedom Crichton Ropati scored a hat-trick as Samoa eliminated them from the tournament.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏉 England knocked out of Women's Rugby League World Cup by Samoa

England are out of the Women's Rugby League World Cup after losing to Samoa. Freedom Crichton Ropati scored a hat-trick as Samoa eliminated them from the tournament.

Source: BBC Sport | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 30 October, 15:50
